resolutions.researcher_notes: No construction/capital cost figure for the Garden Banks Gas Pipeline (30-in, ~50 mi, Garden Banks Block 128 to South Marsh Island 76, offshore Louisiana; certificated in FERC Docket CP96-307-000, built 1996-97 by Shell Gas Pipeline Co./Garden Banks Gas Pipeline LLC) turned up anywhere searched. Checked: (1) both FERC Federal Register notices already on this row (96-20331 Notice of Application, and the govinfo FR-1998-06-01 98-14347 tariff notice) — neither states a project cost, only certificate/tariff procedural facts; (2) Wikipedia's Garden Banks Pipeline article — gives only a 2022 fiscal-year FERC Form 2 OPERATING cost ($60,318,949), which is opex not construction cost, and is not usable for SegmentCost; (3) Enbridge's 2020 Energy Infrastructure Assets factsheet — asset description only, no cost; (4) the archived 2008 offshore-gt.com Garden Banks page — no cost; (5) rextag.com's Garden Banks Gas Pipeline page — no cost; (6) two Oil & Gas Journal articles on the Enchilada platform hub ('Platform Serves As Pipeline Hub, Production Facility'; 'Enchilada platform anchors offshore Louisiana transportation network') — both describe the GBGP system's ownership/routing/capacity but neither gives a cost figure; (7) Amerada Hess Corp's FY1997 10-K (SEC EDGAR, Hess held 20% of GBGP via Hess Garden Banks Gas Gathering Inc.) — mentions the Garden Banks OIL FIELD/platforms repeatedly but never the gas pipeline or any associated capex; (8) general web search for 'Garden Banks Gas Pipeline construction cost/million' and variants naming the certificate docket, the Enchilada platform, and the Shell/Hess partners — the only cost figures that surface are for unrelated projects (the $270M Nautilus/Manta Ray system near Ship Shoal 207, and Enbridge's 2020 $613M acquisition of Shell's 80% interest, which is an acquisition price decades after construction, not a construction cost). No 1990s trade-press (Oil & Gas Journal, Pipeline & Gas Journal) archive with a specific dollar figure was found via search or on the OGJ articles actually retrieved. Leaving SegmentCost/SegmentCostUnits/SegmentCostYear unfilled and this unit UNRESOLVED rather than fabricate or infer a figure.
